    • movePieces

      private void movePieces(ActionEvent e)
      Does the move logic for the pieces logic: If let move is active then it will take the square selected and see if a move is already in play if not then it will take what piece is on the board and then take its x and y position as well as its colour If a move is currently in progress then all the piece is set as the new text and the old and new place as well as the piece is used in validMoveGetter to see if that move was valid.
      Parameters:
      e - the action event
